Packages that use IFind
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.
io.webagent4j.dom
The backend-neutral live-element vocabulary shared by the locator, action, extraction, and observation subsystems - depends only on immutable, backend-neutral contracts.
io.webagent4j.locator.api
Immutable, backend-neutral locator definitions and the fluent query contracts every semantic search builds on - IFind and ILocator contain no engine logic and no backend-native type.
